title: Improved eyes, proportions and cloth; scalp needs refinement
notes: Eye placement, iris clipping, lower-face proportions and shoulder joins improved. Remaining problems: hard eyelid transitions, exposed smooth scalp, ribbon-like hair, low collar, and stylized likeness. Browser screenshot timed out during continuous 3D rendering.
review_method: Manual visual review of actual Eevee render; subjective, not measured likeness.
